findings.issue: Common noun לֹג (H3849, construct) is left as the untranslated lemma “log” instead of a Spanish noun.
כַּף is construct to the definite priest and the definite feminine adjective; bare “palma” does not mark that definiteness.

notes: Verbs, priest (twice), oil, על, and the left adjective match; only the measure is untranslated.
